QuestInfo.name: [Riena Strait] Seal Suspicions
QuestInfo.1: Putan suspects that the local #rSeals#k could be the culprits. Talk to #bDachi#k at the #bGlacial Observatory#k to get to the bottom of this case.
QuestInfo.2: You talked to #bDachi#k at the #bGlacial Observatory#k about the local problems.

0.0: You have taught me valuable lesson. If witch is not witch, then friends must not be friends! This must be work of crafty #rSeals#k!
0.1: The logic of Putan is perfect and unbreakable! I have been told by very reliable Penguin warriors that #rSeals attacked#k them.
0.2: So, if it is not witch who causes problems among us, it is #rSeals#k. That is that.

yes.0: You will talk to #rSeals#k for us, yes? And discover truth.\r\n#b#e(Talk to Dachi.)

no.0: You will trust me on this!

1.0: I think tha' #bPutan#k fella's suspectin' us for wha' 'appened. #eIt's no' fair!#n

yes.0: Give us a minute. Me blood's up, ya know?
